notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.content:
Gameplay
[list]
[*] Added the Krimpus.
[*] Added Green Caps.
[*] New Winter level and debris.
[/list]

Other changes / bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Full controller support!
[*] New achievement for using the Bullet Pixie.
[*] Removed chance of exit in forest not attached to wall.
[*] Removed chance of monsters sometimes spawning out of bounds.
[/list]

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Autumn Update!
notes.content:
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Added a Necromancer that can summon the dead.
[*] Added a Witch that can summon demonic servants.
[*] Added A Bullet Pixie item that replenishes bullets the player is out of when they get a melee kill.
[*] New Graveyard level and debris.
[*] Zombies and imps have new spawning animations. 
[/list]

Other changes / bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved spawn distribution in standard mode so less likely to see clumps of the same enemy.
[*] Bullets loaded in non currently selected gun would be discarded on level complete.
[*] Sometimes monsters wouldn't display slain frame when slain in multiplayer.
[*] Trolls sometimes wouldn't show windup animation in multiplayer.
[*] Improved physics optimization for large amount of monsters.
[/list]

notes.title: Arcade Mode Update Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] fixed issue where playing a different mode after arcade mode sometimes wouldn't show ammo in shop
[*] fixed issue where unfired bullets still in the gun chamber on level end wouldn't go back into bullet supply
[*] radio assistant now tells you when you've slain enough monsters to clear the level
[*] raised volume on noise zombies make when they spawn mid level
[/list]

notes.title: Arcade Mode and Sword Range Indicator
notes.content:
Gameplay changes:
[list]
[*] An arcade mode where you can play through the game with unlimited ammo
[*] When you are in range to deal damage with a sword, the reticle will light up
[*] New achievement for beating Standard Mode without firing any bullets
[/list]

Other changes / bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Key binds should now save correctly
[*] Some chat quality of life updates like not fading if you're currently typing a message
[*] Capped the number of baby spiders that spawn from goblin kings (was an issue in high rounds of endless)
[*] New link to discord on main menu - should help with organizing coop play
[*] A few typos in bestiary entries
[*] Added some tips to loading screens
[/list]

notes.title: Slow Down mode and Discord Server
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Added a slow mode for people that requested an easy mode, it reduces enemy speed by 40%!

I've also created a discord server for people coordinating coop.
[b][url=https://discord.gg/gHyegFQ225]You can join here![/url][/b]

Other changes include:
[list]
[*] zombies will make a noise when they spawn from stealth
[*] Shop now offers 4 item options instead of 3
[*] server browser will now show public games in progress
[/list]

Bugs/UI fixed:
[list]
[*] if an enemy was killed before it finished shifting it wouldn't play death animation
[*] chat is more user friendly
[*] order of bullet counts in shop now reflects their order on the table
[*] fixed typos in bestiary descriptions
[*] Sometimes post game info would show wrong level the run reached
[/list]
